title: Seaspell Sands
meta_description: Located on the largest lot in exclusive gated Seanest Village, enjoy 30A the easy way—golf cart, bikes, gated community pool, and a fully stocked home built for comfort.

normalized_matching_profile.name: Seaspell Sands
normalized_matching_profile.description: DescriptionHOME HIGHLIGHTS- GOLF CART Included- 4 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes- Rooftop Deck with Slight Gulf Views- Spectacular 540 sq. ft. Covered Patio- Located in the Gated Community of Seanest Village on 30A - Quick Bike or Golf Cart Ride to Beach, Restaurants, Shopping & MoreSeaspell Sands sits on the largest lot in Seanest Village, offering privacy, outdoor living, and Gulf views in Seagrove Beach.The open living area features oversized sofas, hardwood floors, and a gas fireplace. The fully equipped kitchen includes quartz counters, double ovens, a large island, and pantry space—ideal for family meals or extended stays.The standout feature is the 540 sq ft covered loggia with outdoor living and dining areas, full summer kitchen, grill, beverage cooler, and TV.The master suite offers a king Tempur-Pedic bed and spa-style bath with soaking tub and oversized shower. Additional bedrooms include a queen ensuite, bunk room, and queen guest room.Includes golf cart, bikes, beach gear, and games. Minutes to Seaside, WaterColor, dining, and beach access.From plush robes and beach bags to a fully equipped garage with beach gear and games for all ages, every detail is curated for comfort, convenience, and entertainment. There is even an office space if you need a get away but can't get away!Ideal for family vacations, snowbirds, and 30–45 day stays.HOME LAYOUT (Sleeps 12)1st Floor- Queen Bedroom: Tempur-Pedic Bed & En-Suite Bath with Large Walk-In Shower- King Guest Bedroom - Hall Bath with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: 2 Sets of Bunk Beds with Built-in Ladder, Flat-Screen TV2nd Floor- Living Room: Seating for 9+ - Pull-Out Sofa- Dining Area: Corner Table for 5-6- Kitchen: Quartz Counters, Stainless Steel Appliances, Gas Range, & Double Oven- Center Island: Seating for 4- Half-Bath w/ Washer & Dryer- 540 sq ft Loggia3rd Floor- Primary King Suite: Free-Standing Tub, Dual Vanities, Walk-In Shower w/ Dual Shower Heads- Private Office SpaceOutdoor- Rooftop Deck- 540 sq. ft. Covered Patio- Outdoor Living w/TV & Dining Area- Full Summer Kitchen: Gas Grill, Beverage Cooler
